newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Expecting U.S. move.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Expecting U.S. move.

text.p: The Australian bond market clawed back some of Thursday's sharp widening against the dollar bloc with the reaction to a potential hike in U.S. interest rates now seen largely priced in.

The short-end of the U.S. curve came under pressure in Tokyo trading, continuing the trend in New York, after Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan hinted strongly that the Federal Open Market Committee meeting will endorse a 25 basis point tightening on March 25.
The largest move on the day was against Canadian debt, which failed to follow a late U.S. rally on Thursday as the Canadian dollar fell on Greenspan's comments.
The Bank of Canada has already suggested that it would not necessarily follow a Fed tightening, which has put its currency under pressure this week.
